originalAlarm.description: Value stored to 'k_crcs' is never read

reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: The alarm reports 'k_crcs = 0' (line 21, inside #ifdef CONFIG_FEATURE_INSMOD_VERSION_CHECKING) as a dead store. When VERSION_CHECKING is true, k_crcs is declared (line 12), set to 0 (line 21), and potentially overwritten at line 25 — but never read in the simplified file. In the real BusyBox insmod code, k_crcs is used extensively for CRC verification logic. The simplified file stripped all subsequent uses. This is a simplification artifact. The known vbdb bug is UndeclaredIdentifier: at line 25, k_crcs is used unconditionally, but is only declared inside #ifdef VERSION_CHECKING, so when VERSION_CHECKING is false k_crcs is undeclared — a completely different issue.
